token.name: Venomeum
token.features: Tax on DEX trades only: 1% burn, 1% automatic liquidity, 1% automatic buyback (accrues, auto-swaps to native, buys VMH and burns it). Automation processes prior trades' tax at the start of each sell.

dex.type: Venomeum Swap — own Uniswap V2 (factory + Router02 + wrapped native), same addresses on both testnets
dex.liquidity: LP tokens are held by the liquidity provider and removable at any time (removeLiquidityETH) — no lock. Proven on-chain: 10% of each pool was withdrawn again after launch.

deployments.proof: Taxed sells burned 2,494 VMH total (tax burns + automatic buyback burn); auto-LP minted extra LP to the owner; 10% LP removal returned ~114,650 VMH + ~0.08 USDC
Taxed sells burned 2,584 VMH total (tax burns + buyback burn of 1,084 VMH); 10% LP removal returned ~114,641 VMH + ETH
Taxed sells from the agent wallet burned 2,495 VMH total (tax burns + automatic buyback burn); 100 LP removed again via removeLiquidityETH

note: Testnet deployments (v5, 2026-11-18). Earlier v1-v4 deployments were superseded during development and are abandoned. Thresholds are set low (1,000 VMH) for testnet demonstration; burn/liquidity/buyback rates are 1%/1%/1% and owner-tunable.
